problems.title: 8. Night Sky.
problems.statement: The attached map shows the sky as it could be observed at 14:00 UT of April 22, 2025.

figures.alt: Complete circular sky map for problem8, including its outer boundary, constellation lines and coloured celestial objects.
figures.caption: Round on Maps and Images. Map for problem 8

parts.statement: Draw on the map as a dotted line the ecliptic and identify with "Ecl".
Draw on the map as a continuous line the celestial equator and identify with "Eqt".
Identify on the map the following 12 constellation, writing their three letter code nearby: Pup, Ant, Lup, Cen, Lyn, Dra, UMa, Pyx, LMi, Per, Vel, Cru.
Identify on the map the following 5 stars, writing the indicated number nearby: 1. Alnilam (ε Ori), 2. Alphard (α Hya), 3. Miram (η Per), 4. Eltanin (γ Dra), 5. Kochab (β UMi).

problems.title: 9. Who is who?
problems.statement:
You are provided with a sheet where images of 9 astronomical objects are shown. Identify these objects marking the correct answer among the listed four. Multiple choose or corrections are not allowed.

![Original nine-image sheet and all printed choices](#nine-object-sheet-astra-root2-20260925)

*[Transcription note: the row/column labels below describe image positions in the original sheet.]*

| Image position | Printed choices, in order |
|---|---|
| Top left | NGC 7331 Galaxy; M1; M31; M101 |
| Top centre | Barred Spiral Galaxy; NGC 300; Pleiades; Globular Cluster |
| Top right | Intermediate spiral Galaxy; Double Star; M7; M78 Nebula |
| Middle left | Solar Radiation; Comet C/2025 A6 (Lemmon); Ikeya-Seki; Comet Hele-Bopp |
| Middle centre | Callisto; Eukelade; Titan; 4 Vesta |
| Middle right | Iapetus; Charon; Orcus; Pluto |
| Bottom left | Skull Nebula; M16; Crab Nebula; Eagle Nebula |
| Bottom centre | Sculptor Galaxy; NGC 4414; Andromeda; Abell 1413 |
| Bottom right | Omega Centauri; M41 Cluster; Embedded cluster; Messier 68 |
